blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Team Philippines’ Amaya Cojuangco delivered the silver medal in the archery women’s compound individual event at the Asian Games 2026 on Thursday, falling to Indonesia’s Nurisa Dian Ashrifah, 139-137, at Ozakaki Chuo Sogo Park. Cojuangco pushed Ashrifah to the limit, but the Indonesian hit a 10 with her final arrow to clinch her country’s first Asian Games gold in archery. It capped a strong run for Cojuangco, who also upset No. 66-ranked Park Jungyoon of South Korea, 142-141, in the semifinals after beating Iran’s Bita Asheghzadeh […]...
